# Al Rostamani Building, Fujairah

> This mid-rise building stands in Fujairah, the east-coast emirate that faces the Gulf of Oman. Its configuration runs from a single basement through a podium level, a first floor and twelve further storeys, giving fourteen levels above ground. Buildings of this scale line the main urban corridor of Fujairah city, which has grown steadily as the emirate's port and industrial economy has expanded.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This building in Fujairah was developed for Al Rostamani, rising from a basement and podium in a B+Podium+1+12 configuration. It was delivered with UNEC as main contractor and Khatib & Alami as consultant. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services across all levels.
